note: Bavli: [Gittin 19a:16](sefaria:Gittin.19a.16) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Pappa the ox herder”. 'Ox herder' (from תורא). Not in paper.

Bavli: [Ketubot 79a:1](sefaria:Ketubot.79a.1) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Naḥman the farmer”. Rav Anan's mocking name for Rav Naḥman (Ketubot 79a:1); also fits Slurs. Paper has only 'רבי יצחק בן חקלא' in the Pesachim 113b quote.

Bavli: [Yoma 19a:5](sefaria:Yoma.19a.5) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Pineḥas the Dresser”. Temple official in charge of priestly vestments (Mishnah Middot / Shekalim, quoted at Yoma 19a:5). Not in paper.

Bavli: [Sanhedrin 44b:13](sefaria:Sanhedrin.44b.13) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Ba’aya the tax collector”. 'כי ההוא מעשה דבעיא מיכסא' (Steinsaltz: 'Ba’aya the tax collector'). מיכסא here may name the office or the toll itself; the other 5 Bavli segments use מיכסא for ‘toll’.
